tasks.title: Drive-backup uploader: copy tar.zst archive + .diff to gdrive rclone remote, queue-on-failure (never raises)
acceptance_criteria: tools/drive_backup/uploader.py is a NEW single-file, whole-file, stdlib-only module (no third-party imports).

uploader.upload(archive_result, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE, runner, queue_dir, now) invokes `rclone copyto <src> <remote_path>/<name>` through the injected runner for BOTH the archive and the diff with the asserted argv shape.
On runner success upload returns UploadResult(uploaded=True, queued=False, remote_path=..., error=None).

On ANY failure (nonzero rc, runner raising, rclone-not-found) upload copies BOTH artifacts into queue_dir/<name>, writes a <name>.queued.json sidecar (intended remote_path + error + now()), returns UploadResult(uploaded=False, queued=True, remote_path=..., error=<structured str>), and NEVER raises.

uploader.drive_backup_drain(queue_dir, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE, runner) re-attempts queued uploads via the runner, clears local copy + sidecar on success, leaves failures queued, is idempotent (absent name = no-op), and never raises; returns list[UploadResult].
queue_dir and every write path are caller-supplied seams; no default write path is `.`, os.getcwd(), or __file__'s dir; scratch (if any) uses tempfile under the system temp dir.

Every file handle is closed deterministically (context managers / try-finally); no nested .git/, no real subprocess/network in any tested path; staging worktree stays removable by `git worktree remove -f`.

spec.objective: Build a NEW single-file, whole-file, stdlib-only module tools/drive_backup/uploader.py that copies the drive-backup tar.zst archive and its .diff to a Google-Drive rclone remote (gdrive:repo-push-backups/<repo>/) via an injected runner seam, failing LOUDLY but NON-BLOCKING: on any rclone error it queues the artifacts locally with a sidecar and returns a queued result, never raising; a drain function retries the queue idempotently. IMPL-only against the pre-committed RED oracle tests/drive_backup/test_uploader.py.
functional_requirements: DEFAULT_REMOTE == "gdrive:" — the module-level constant naming the configured Google-Drive rclone remote (no credentials in the repo; the conf lives at ~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf outside both repos).
remote_dir_for(repo, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE) is a pure path helper returning "<remote>repo-push-backups/<repo>/".

upload(archive_result, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE, runner, queue_dir, now) invokes `rclone copyto <archive_path> <remote_path>/<name>` through the injected runner seam for BOTH the archive and the diff, with the argv shape asserted by the oracle; no real rclone is run.
On runner success, upload returns UploadResult(uploaded=True, queued=False, remote_path=<resolved remote dir>, error=None).

On ANY failure (nonzero rc, runner raising, rclone-not-found), upload copies BOTH artifacts into queue_dir/<name> via stdlib shutil, writes a small <name>.queued.json sidecar recording the intended remote_path + error + now(), returns UploadResult(uploaded=False, queued=True, remote_path=..., error=<structured str>), and NEVER raises.

drive_backup_drain(queue_dir, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE, runner) scans queue_dir for queued artifacts, re-attempts `rclone copyto` per artifact via the runner, removes the local copy + sidecar on success (idempotent: an absent name is a no-op), leaves failures queued, never raises, and returns list[UploadResult].
spec.interfaces: tools/drive_backup/uploader.py: DEFAULT_REMOTE = "gdrive:"; remote_dir_for(repo, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE) -> str; UploadResult dataclass with fields (uploaded: bool, queued: bool, remote_path, error); upload(archive_result, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE, runner, queue_dir, now) -> UploadResult (never raises; success->uploaded, failure->queued); drive_backup_drain(queue_dir, *, remote=DEFAULT_REMOTE, runner) -> list[UploadResult] (idempotent retry). Consumes archiver.ArchiveResult (fields archive_path, diff_path, base_sha, manifest). All rclone calls go through the injected runner; now() is the injected clock.
edge_cases: On an rclone failure (nonzero rc, runner raising, or rclone-not-found) upload NEVER raises and queues BOTH artifacts into queue_dir/<name> plus a <name>.queued.json sidecar, returning UploadResult(uploaded=False, queued=True).
drive_backup_drain is IDEMPOTENT: an empty queue_dir is a no-op, a name already absent is skipped, and artifacts whose retry fails again STAY queued; the drain never raises.
non_goals: Integration wiring into the pre-push hook orchestration is OUT OF SCOPE here — deferred to the dependent drive-backup-hook-runner and drive-backup-installer leaves; this leaf only builds the uploader seam (its integration_tests are intentionally empty for this reason).
No real rclone invocation, no network, no Google-Drive API, no `rclone config`/login performed by code (that is the user-setup doc).

No credential reading/writing in any tested path — runner is the injected seam; no secrets in the repo (the credential lives in ~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf outside both repos; this module references only the remote NAME).
No archive building (consumes an ArchiveResult from drive-backup-archiver).
No edits to any existing file (the module is NEW); no edits to any _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE file; no third-party imports (stdlib only).
Does NOT author its own oracle — tests/drive_backup/test_uploader.py is the hand-authored RED precondition and is authoritative if a pinned name differs.
spec.implementation_notes: Stdlib only (dataclasses, json, shutil, pathlib/os, tempfile). RESOURCE HYGIENE is BUILD-BLOCKING (sibling archiver-impl died auto_commit_failed_r1): NEVER default queue_dir or any write path inside the repo/working tree — it is a caller-supplied seam; default destinations MUST NOT be `.`, os.getcwd(), or __file__'s dir; any scratch uses tempfile under the system temp dir. Close EVERY file handle deterministically (context managers / try-finally) — leave no open handles, no .lock/-wal/-shm sidecars, no temp dirs inside the repo, so `git worktree remove -f` exits 0. NEVER create a nested .git/ and NEVER spawn a real subprocess/network call in any tested path (rclone is the injected runner seam only). Build remote paths with simple string joins on remote_dir_for (which already ends in `/`). The structured error string should capture the failure kind (rc / exception / not-found). check_wired is satisfied orphan-by-design via the committed static manifest config/drive_backup_modules.yaml — do NOT add a *_wired command.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: A fake injected runner (records argv; returns success rc=0 / nonzero rc / raises / simulates rclone-not-found per test), a fixed injected now() clock, a tmp_path-based queue_dir (NEVER inside the repo), and a minimal stub ArchiveResult with archive_path and diff_path pointing at small tmp files. No real rclone, no network, no credentials.

token_budget_ratio.note: Test tokens >= 1.5x implementation tokens: the contract is dominated by argv-shape assertions, success/queued branch coverage, never-raise verification across failure modes, and drain idempotency.

tasks.title: Implement git pre-push hook installer module
acceptance_criteria: Create tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py module containing SENTINEL, DEFAULT_REPOS, render_shim, InstallResult, install, and main.
Ensure the module is stdlib-only and passes pytest tests/drive_backup/test_install_hooks.py -q.

spec.objective: Build the new, single-file, whole-file, stdlib-only module tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py that can render and install the pre-push hook shim.
functional_requirements: DEFAULT_REPOS == ['/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR', '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2'] and SENTINEL marker is defined
render_shim(janusmask_root) returns a #!/usr/bin/env bash shim bounded by SENTINEL, embedding the ABSOLUTE janusmask_root, python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner, and an unconditional exit 0
render_shim(..., chained_hook=...) runs the saved original hook with the same stdin before the backup step
install writes the shim when no hook exists (action created) and sets mode 0o755 via the fs seam
install rewrites in place when a SENTINEL-managed shim exists (action updated, idempotent — never duplicated)
install moves a foreign non-managed hook to pre-push.pre-janusmask and chains to it (action chained), and dry_run=True computes the action/target without writing (action suffixed :dry)
spec.interfaces: tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py: SENTINEL ('# >>> janusmask-drive-backup >>>'); JANUSMASK_ROOT default; DEFAULT_REPOS (['/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR', '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2']); render_shim(janusmask_root, *, chained_hook=None) -> str; InstallResult dataclass{repo, hook_path, action, ok}; install(repo_roots=DEFAULT_REPOS, *, fs, janusmask_root=JANUSMASK_ROOT, dry_run=False) -> list[InstallResult]; main(argv=None, *, fs=None) -> int.
edge_cases: re-running install on a managed shim is IDEMPOTENT (action updated, sentinel never duplicated)
a pre-existing FOREIGN hook is PRESERVED (moved to pre-push.pre-janusmask) and chained, never destroyed
non_goals: Live integration — actually writing .git/hooks/pre-push in either repo — is OUT OF SCOPE here; deferred to the user-run install step. The created/updated/chained/dry branches are exercised against an injected fake fs seam only.
No execution of git, push, or the hook itself.
No edits to any existing tracked file in either repo.
spec.implementation_notes:
Write the installer-impl module without third-party dependencies, adhering to the standard library module design. Embed absolute janusmask_root in NobleGreedv2 shim so it finds tools.drive_backup.hook_runner correctly.

# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/drive_backup/test_install_hooks.py
```python
"""RED oracle for leaf `drive-backup-installer`.

Pins `tools/drive_backup/install_hooks.py`:
SENTINEL ('# >>> janusmask-drive-backup >>>'), DEFAULT_REPOS
(['/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR', '/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2']),
render_shim(janusmask_root, *, chained_hook=None) -> str,
InstallResult{repo, hook_path, action, ok},
install(repo_roots=DEFAULT_REPOS, *, fs, janusmask_root=JANUSMASK_ROOT,
dry_run=False) -> list[InstallResult], main(argv=None, *, fs=None) -> int.

Hermetic: the `fs` seam is a fake in-memory filesystem; NO real
.git/hooks writes, no git/push/hook execution. Tests assert shim text
shape, the created/updated/chained/dry branches, idempotency, foreign-
hook preservation, and the executable-bit set.
"""
import pytest

from tools.drive_backup import install_hooks
from tools.drive_backup.install_hooks import (
    DEFAULT_REPOS,
    SENTINEL,
    InstallResult,
    install,
    render_shim,
)


JM_ROOT = "/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR"


class FakeFS:
    """In-memory filesystem seam: exists/read/write/move/chmod."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.files = {}        # path -> text
        self.modes = {}        # path -> int
        self.dirs = set()

    def exists(self, path):
        return path in self.files

    def read_text(self, path):
        return self.files[path]

    def write_text(self, path, text):
        self.files[path] = text

    def move(self, src, dst):
        self.files[dst] = self.files.pop(src)
        if src in self.modes:
            self.modes[dst] = self.modes.pop(src)

    def chmod(self, path, mode):
        self.modes[path] = mode

    def makedirs(self, path, exist_ok=True):
        self.dirs.add(path)


# ---- constants & shim text ----------------------------------------------

def test_default_repos_and_sentinel():
    assert DEFAULT_REPOS == [
        "/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR",
        "/home/xnihil0zer0/NobleGreedv2",
    ]
    assert SENTINEL == "# >>> janusmask-drive-backup >>>"


def test_render_shim_shape():
    shim = render_shim(JM_ROOT)
    assert shim.startswith("#!/usr/bin/env bash")
    assert SENTINEL in shim
    # Absolute JanusMask root embedded so NobleGreedv2's hook finds the module.
    assert JM_ROOT in shim
    assert "python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner" in shim
    # The backup step must always exit 0 (never blocks a push).
    assert "exit 0" in shim


def test_render_shim_chains_to_original_when_given():
    chained = "/home/xnihil0zer0/JanusMaskJR/.git/hooks/pre-push.pre-janusmask"
    shim = render_shim(JM_ROOT, chained_hook=chained)
    assert chained in shim
    # Still exits 0 for the backup step and references the module.
    assert "exit 0" in shim
    assert "python -m tools.drive_backup.hook_runner" in shim


# ---- install branches ----------------------------------------------------

def test_install_creates_when_no_hook_exists():
    fs = FakeFS()
    results = install([JM_ROOT], fs=fs, janusmask_root=JM_ROOT)
    assert len(results) == 1
    r = results[0]
    assert isinstance(r, InstallResult)
    assert r.repo == JM_ROOT
    assert r.hook_path.endswith("/.git/hooks/pre-push")
    assert r.action == "created"
    assert r.ok is True
    # Shim written with sentinel and made executable (0o755).
    assert SENTINEL in fs.read_text(r.hook_path)
    assert fs.modes.get(r.hook_path) == 0o755


def test_install_updates_managed_shim_idempotently():
    fs = FakeFS()
    hook = f"{JM_ROOT}/.git/hooks/pre-push"
    # Pre-seed an EXISTING managed shim (contains the sentinel).
    fs.write_text(hook, render_shim(JM_ROOT))
    results = install([JM_ROOT], fs=fs, janusmask_root=JM_ROOT)
    r = results[0]
    assert r.action == "updated"
    assert r.ok is True
    # Idempotent: sentinel appears exactly once (not duplicated/stacked).
    assert fs.read_text(hook).count(SENTINEL) == 1


def test_install_chains_foreign_hook_and_preserves_it():
    fs = FakeFS()
    hook = f"{JM_ROOT}/.git/hooks/pre-push"
    foreign = "#!/bin/sh\necho legacy-lint-gate\nexit 1\n"
    fs.write_text(hook, foreign)
    results = install([JM_ROOT], fs=fs, janusmask_root=JM_ROOT)
    r = results[0]
    assert r.action == "chained"
    assert r.ok is True
    # Original foreign hook preserved at the .pre-janusmask sidecar.
    saved = f"{hook}.pre-janusmask"
    assert fs.exists(saved)
    assert fs.read_text(saved) == foreign
    # New managed shim chains to the saved original.
    new_shim = fs.read_text(hook)
    assert SENTINEL in new_shim
    assert saved in new_shim


def test_install_dry_run_does_not_write():
    fs = FakeFS()
    results = install([JM_ROOT], fs=fs, janusmask_root=JM_ROOT, dry_run=True)
    r = results[0]
    assert r.action.endswith(":dry")
    # No real write occurred under dry_run.
    assert not fs.exists(r.hook_path)
    assert fs.modes == {}


def test_install_targets_both_default_repos():
    fs = FakeFS()
    results = install(DEFAULT_REPOS, fs=fs, janusmask_root=JM_ROOT)
    repos = {r.repo for r in results}
    assert repos == set(DEFAULT_REPOS)
    for r in results:
        assert r.hook_path == f"{r.repo}/.git/hooks/pre-push"
        assert SENTINEL in fs.read_text(r.hook_path)

```
